purpose: Compare the historical Point_data artifact chronology with the later public Metrics1 producer-like notebook, PCA implementations, and subtree API surface. This receipt distinguishes algorithm-family similarity from exact execution provenance.

historical_artifact.interpretation: The December 2025 commit adds only the binary data file; it does not bind that artifact to a source notebook, exact PCA function version, or execution receipt.

public_metrics1_notebook.commit_message: Paper submission update. Remove tracked Data artifacts and add preprocessing notebooks and revised analysis code.
public_metrics1_notebook.conclusion: This later public notebook documents a related metric pipeline, but it is not a complete textual producer for the December 2025 24-column artifact. Its bulk application/concatenation is commented out and no pickle save is present.

implementation.normalization: eigenvalues normalized to sum to 1 when PCA=True

earlier_public_geojax_snapshot.limitation: This is a dated public GeoJax source snapshot and candidate ancestor-family evidence; no historical execution receipt binds this exact function to Point_data.pkl.

implementation.robust_covariance: custom Huber M-estimator in robust_covariance_xyz with c=1.5, tol=1e-6, max_iter=100
implementation.explicit_right_handed_basis_correction: flip the third eigenvector if (v0 cross v1) dot v2 is negative
implementation.normalization: eigenvalues normalized to sum to 1 when norm=True

later_public_neurosetta_pca.timing_boundary: The inspected public coordinate_pca wrapper and PCA utility path appear in 2026-08 public history, after the December 2025 artifact. This does not rule out private/local predecessor code, but it does not establish that the currently published function generated the historical file.

observed_semantic_differences: The inspected GeoJax function defaults to row-oriented eigenvectors; the later NeuRosetta coordinate_pca contract returns eigenvectors as columns.
GeoJax's non-robust covariance uses bias=True (denominator n); later NeuRosetta covariance_xyz uses denominator n-1.
The later NeuRosetta PCA implementation explicitly enforces a right-handed basis by correcting the third eigenvector; the inspected GeoJax implementation has no corresponding explicit correction.
Both inspected implementations expose robust Huber-like covariance with c=1.5, tol=1e-6 and max_iter=100, which supports algorithm-family similarity but not implementation identity.

oldest_visible_git_commit.interpretation: The oldest visible commit tree is metadata-only; a commit author timestamp alone does not establish when a repository was publicly available.

first_inspected_code_snapshot.title: v0.1.1 — core utility, counting properties, plotting, io

dated_editor_history_snapshot.caution: This is a retained editor-history snapshot imported into the later repository, not a versioned executed producer or proof that no other local file existed.

earliest_public_code_boundary.conclusion: The earliest inspected active NeuRosetta code snapshot in the GitHub repository is dated 2026-01-20, after the historical 2025-12-09 Point_data artifact. That active snapshot does not include coordinate_pca or a PCA module. The current coordinate_pca/PCA paths are later public source. This narrows the public-source boundary but does not exclude private/local code.

retained_editor_history_snapshot.caution: The filename timestamp is an editor-history label, not a Git commit timestamp. The active public source snapshot itself is observed at the July 31, 2025 revision.

angle_helpers.minimum_theta: Use vg.signed_angle(v1,v2,look=plane,units='rad'), then fold the result into the minimum rotation interval around +/- pi/2.
angle_helpers.align_eigen_single: Compute minimum_theta(evecs[evec_ind], axis, perspective), rotate both coordinates and eigenvectors around that perspective axis.

runtime_reproducibility_caveat.interpretation: The code is a real, public historical PCA implementation candidate, but the shipped dependency metadata does not pin scikit-learn or provide a complete installation binding. Exact runtime/version used for Point_data remains unknown.

legacy_neurosetta_pca_candidate.interpretation: This legacy implementation is a stronger public pre-artifact candidate than relying only on the later 2026 NeuRosetta coordinate_pca API. It does not prove the historical Point_data producer called this function or used these exact installed package versions.

subtree_api_comparison.comparison: The legacy root-selection score and current public subgraph score use the same algebraic formula. The public PP3 call name is absent from the inspected current main code search, and the methods are not shown to be byte-identical or behaviorally identical.
limitations: Formula agreement establishes algorithm-family correspondence only.

The legacy helper simplifies the tree before ranking branch candidates and maps the chosen coordinate back to the original graph; the current implementation computes subtree scores via a topological pass and exposes a different API surface.
The exact implementation invoked by PP3 in the historical December 2025 producer remains unbound.

proven: The 2025-12-09 Point_data commit adds only the binary artifact.

Metrics1_Point_data.ipynb first appears in public file history on 2026-08-10 and its visible metric function generates 23 columns, omits the historical Subtype_evDir fields, and contains no active bulk save operation.
The public NeuRosetta coordinate_pca wrapper and PCA utility appear in public file history in August 2026, after the historical artifact.
The inspected GeoJax and current NeuRosetta PCA implementations differ in eigenvector layout, covariance denominator and explicit handedness correction.
The legacy root-selection score and current NeuRosetta subgraph score share the same algebraic formula, while the public PP3 method name does not appear in the inspected current API search.

The public NeuRosetta repository's first inspected active code snapshot (v0.1.1, 2026-01-20) postdates the historical Point_data binary; its coordinates.py contains only vertex_coordinates and edge_coordinates, and its Tree class has no coordinate_pca method.

The inspected legacy Neurosetta source contains a pre-August-2026 PCA implementation using sklearn MinCovDet by default, NumPy eigendecomposition, eigenvalue normalization/sorting, and row-oriented eigenvectors by default. This establishes a plausible public algorithm-family candidate predating the historical Point_data binary, but not an artifact-specific execution binding.

The inspected parent tree before the historical Point_data commit contains only .gitignore, README.md, and Notebooks/ANOVA_analysis.ipynb; that notebook reads Point_data.pkl from a separate local T45_Morpho_data workspace. The 2025-12-09 commit adds only Data/Point_data.pkl.
